verdict: Leads are coming in, but Google spend is producing very little return.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 38 leads at an average cost of $97.93 per lead — all 38 came through Meta, where your cost per lead ran $48.34. Google Ads consumed $1,884.38 of your $3,721.38 in total spend and returned only 3 conversions, a cost per lead of $628 that is critically out of line with the rest of your account. Your pipeline shows 110 new opportunities entered this period, but none have advanced to appointments or closed cases, which points to a follow-up or intake gap rather than an advertising problem. We are actively realigning Google Ads to recover efficiency, and your creative production milestone is being moved forward to strengthen ad assets across both channels. Expect tighter Google spend allocation and a cleaner pipeline workflow to be in place before the next reporting window.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads is spending at a high rate with very few leads to show for it this period.
watch_item.fix: Spend allocation is being restructured and campaign targeting is under review to bring Google in line with Meta's efficiency.
